personality_one_liner: A sovereign-grade, authoritative institutional reference app using deep cinematic darks, frosted glass, and gold/green accents to project absolute trust and global scale.

spacing.rule: Generous, editorial margins. Use lg/xl padding to avoid density, giving the policy text a high-end brochure feel.

do's: Use heavy blur (glass) on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to create cinematic depth against the dark backgrounds.
Use glass overlays on the brand hero card 'GOV·POWER·TRADE' over the dark map.
dont's: Do not use glass on dense comparison tables or form inputs; keep utilitarian elements solid for legibility.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Introduce NESU's sovereign authority with a cinematic brand card and clearly delineate its institutional purpose.

states.error: Standard dark card with retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Trilingual switcher (EN/FR/ع). Hero: High-end 'GOV·POWER·TRADE' glass card stacked over the dark world map background. Below: A prominent 'who this is for / who this is not for' two-column or stacked card layout with refined borders.

screens.name: How It Works
screens.purpose: Explain the zero-interest, non-crypto architectural layers.
screens.layout: Top: 'SERVICE ≠ MONEY' callout block (subtle warning/info styling). Body: A vertical scroll of 6 layer cards. Each card uses a brandTertiary tinted icon container and Cormorant Garamond title, presenting the layers as a definitive stack.

screens.name: Green Corridors
screens.purpose: Showcase global trade corridors and their statuses.
screens.layout: Top: 16:9 autoplaying muted explainer video. Below: Vertical list of 5 Corridor Token cards. Each card features a glass surface, token name, and a prominent status tag (e.g., 'Lead Corridor' in brandPrimary, 'Roadmap' in muted styling). No purchase buttons.

screens.name: Comparison
screens.purpose: Contrast NESU's stability against Bitcoin's volatility.
screens.layout: A structured, highly legible grid/table. NESU column highlighted with a subtle brandTertiary background tint. Bitcoin column muted. Below table: A 'Real-World Precedents' section featuring small logo/icon rows for Project mBridge, Buna, etc.

screens.name: Pledge of Support
screens.purpose: Capture symbolic institutional alignment without actual fund transfer.
screens.layout: Top: Live region-broken-down pledge counter (grid of 6 regions with numbers). Middle: Clean, single-column form (Name, Institution, Country, Email, Tier, Region). Bottom: On submit, replaces form with the generated 'Certificate of Pledged Support' (glass card with watermark text overlay).

screens.name: Research & Governance
screens.purpose: Provide access to multilingual sovereign-grade PDF briefs.
screens.layout: List of documents. Each row has a PDF icon, document title in the respective language, and an open action. Uses a consistent 56pt tappable height.

hero_world_map.alt: Dark world map with glowing network lines

nesu_logo_fallback.alt: Gold laurel wreath on dark surface (fallback visual)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Trilingual Header & RTL Layout. The app must support English, French, and Arabic. Build a robust `I18nManager` context. The language switcher (EN / FR / ع) must live in a persistent header across ALL screens and fit cleanly within 390px without clipping.

CRITICAL: 6-Tab Bottom Navigation. The user explicitly requested 6 tabs. To prevent cramping, use a highly compact tab bar. Rely on `Phosphor` icons, potentially hiding text labels on smaller devices or utilizing a slightly scrollable/packed flex layout to ensure 6 items fit beautifully.
CRITICAL: Footer Disclaimer. A permanent footer disclaimer ('NESU is a conceptual research...') must exist at the bottom of EVERY screen's scrollview (or pinned above the tab bar).

THEME: Stick rigorously to the dark mode palette (surface: #050A10). Ensure text contrast is AAA. Use the brandPrimary (#D4AF37 - Gold) and brandSecondary (#1E4E3B - Green) strictly as strategic accents, not overwhelming backgrounds.

TYPOGRAPHY: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for authoritative titles and 'Geist' for dense policy text. For Arabic text, ensure an equivalent highly legible, professional font fallback is configured in the text components.

COMPARISON TABLE: The NESU vs Bitcoin table needs to be extremely clean. Do not use generic borders; use `divider` tokens and subtle background tints (`brandTertiary` for the NESU column) to create hierarchy.

PLEDGE FORM: This form captures non-monetary, symbolic pledges. NO payment inputs. The 'Certificate of Pledged Support' should look like an authoritative document (glass card overlaying a watermark text).

Use image_generation_tool (if available in your toolset) to generate the specific 'green globe-with-leaf emblem inside a gold laurel wreath' and the 'GOV·POWER·TRADE' hero background, using the provided images here as layout fallbacks.
